Patient information

Frequently asked questions

What to know before you visit The Lady Dentist.

How do I make an appointment?

Use the WhatsApp button or call +92 321 5928003. Ask for a suitable time and wait for reception to confirm it.

Can I ask for a treatment price first?

Yes. Ask for the consultation fee and whether imaging is separate. Treatment pricing may require an exam so the dentist can explain the options and total cost.

What should I bring?

Bring any relevant records or X-rays you already have and a list of medications if applicable. Ask reception if anything else is required.

Can children visit?

Ask reception about your child’s age and reason for the visit so they can arrange the appropriate appointment.

How can I change my appointment?

Contact reception on the same WhatsApp number or by phone to agree a different time.

Can I check opening hours before travelling?

Yes. Call or message the clinic for current hours and confirm your appointment before travelling.
